_comment: Per-1M-token USD prices. User-editable. Used to compute cost_usd per attempt. Update as vendor pricing changes. Every rate below is the vendor's Standard (non-batch, non-priority) short-context rate; cost_usd does not model prompt caching, long-context surcharges, batch/flex discounts or fast-mode premiums.
